responsibility: Declares the public pretty-printing interface for GCC tree IR. It exposes debug printers, generic declaration/statement/expression emitters, dump_generic_node and declaration printers, operator and call-name helpers, OpenMP-clause formatting hooks, identifier and location printers, and utility macros used by diagnostics and dump code that need human-readable tree output.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public pretty-printing entry points, helper macros, and formatting hooks used elsewhere in GCC. Unlike the .cc file, it is the interface surface for tree printing rather than the implementation of formatting behavior.
